jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.




THE ROLE

As Director of Sales - Mid-Market, you’ll be responsible for owning and scaling revenue in our mid-market segment. You’ll manage a team of quota-carrying AEs, drive forecast accuracy, and operationalize a repeatable sales motion.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and optimization: coaching reps to win today while tightening the systems that support growth tomorrow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


REVENUE OWNERSHIP

 - Own a mid-market revenue number and deliver consistent, predictable growth

 - Ensure healthy pipeline coverage and strong conversion across all stages

 - Support deals through late-stage execution, pricing, and close

 - Deliver accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts

 - Create new processes, sales motions, and programs to drive pipeline and bookings


TEAM MANAGEMENT

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Mid-Market Account Executives

 - Drive best practices in discovery, MEDDICC, and value-based selling

 - Run 1:1s, pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and forecast calls

 - Hire and ramp new AEs in partnership with Enablement


PROCESS & SCALE

 - Standardize and improve the mid-market sales motion

 - Partner with RevOps to optimize CRM hygiene, dashboards, and KPIs

 - Collaborate with Marketing on lead quality, campaigns, and conversion

 - Partner with Customer Success on handoffs, expansion signals, and renewals


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT

 - Provide structured feedback to Product on roadmap gaps and buyer objections

 - Surface competitive insights and positioning to GTM leadership

 - Contribute to pricing, packaging, and territory strategy as we scale




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR


EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including 2+ years managing AEs

 - Proven success selling to mid-market accounts (100–1,000 employees)

 - Experience in Series A–C environments with defined but evolving processes

 - Background selling technical, DevTools, or developer-adjacent products preferred


SKILLS

 - Strong forecasting discipline and pipeline inspection skills

 - Excellent sales coaching and deal strategy capabilities

 - Comfort selling into technical buyers (Engineering, DevOps, Platform teams)

 - Data-driven, systems-minded approach to sales management


LEADERSHIP STYLE

 - High accountability, low ego

 - Servant leader

 - Hands on but not a micromanager

 - Coach-first mindset with a bias toward action

 - Able to balance speed with rigor

This role is based in San Francisco. We are hybrid, we work 3 days a week in our San Francisco office.

jobs.title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.




ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is an AI Code Review platform that helps software developers ship better code by eliminating the manual effort from the code review cycle. CodeRabbit combines Generative AI models with linters and static code analyzers to deliver codebase-aware reviews that catch and fix errors before they hit production. CodeRabbit customizes its recommendations based on your coding style and delivers code reviews directly in your git platform eliminating the need to manage another interface. CodeRabbit elevates the knowledge base across your team by providing an expert-level engineer always at hand that you can rely on to catch 90%+ errors, improve your code quality, and merge PRs 4x faster.




ROLE OVERVIEW

At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional, passionate Commercial Customer Success Manager to join our growing customer success organization in the Americas theater. As a founding member of the customer success management team, you will ensure our customers realize value with our AI-powered code review platform. You will own the full customer journey, from kickoff to renewal and expansion. You will build and maintain strong relationships across your book of business, and you will be a champion for our customers – a vocal advocate who goes above and beyond to ensure our customers thrive.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 1. Build strong, meaningful relationships with our customers and proactively seek to understand their business objectives and expectations

 2. Drive engagement and adoption throughout the full customer journey

 3. Own a book of business to include renewals and expansion opportunities (for customers with <5,000 employees)

 4. Become a product expert and understand all components of CodeRabbit

 5. Educate customers on the best product usage, ensuring they maximize the value out of it

 6. Champion customer needs internally, leveraging your customer knowledge to advocate for them and influence the product roadmap

 7. Relentlessly focus on solving customer challenges by effectively communicating specific benefits and best practices of CodeRabbit

 8. Own customer-facing communications to ensure a professional and concise message

 9. Develop and present periodic reviews to customer leadership




QUALIFICATIONS

Great candidates often have these qualifications:

 1. At least 3+ years of experience in customer success or account management

 2. Technical competency to understand CodeRabbit’s software and build strong relationships with highly technical prospects and key business stakeholders

 3. Customer Obsession: a passion to deliver a high-quality customer experience and a curiosity to help solve their problems

 4. Strong knowledge of the customer success space, including experience with negotiations and procurement processes

 5. Comfortable and proficient with various sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, SPICED, and Command of Message

 6. Ability to establish trust at the CxO level as well as with software development practitioners

 7. Familiarity with modern software development practices, version control systems, and the software development ecosystem, e.g. Git, GitHub, CI/CD, VS Code, Cursor

 8. Excellent communication skills: business fluency in spoken and written English

 9. Ability to travel about 25% of the time to meet with customers




“NICE TO HAVE”

Great candidates may also have one or more of these qualifications:

 1. Experience with code review processes and tools

 2. Familiarity with AI, software developer, and open source technologies

 3. Experience with GTM at early-stage, high-growth, VC-backed startups

 4. Familiarity with Git providers, e.g. GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Azure DevOps

 5. Experience with major cloud providers and cloud-native technologies

 6. Familiarity with observability, RCA, and debugging practices




OUR VALUES

 1. Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence

 2. Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

 3. Persistent Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

 4. Impact-Driven Creators: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

 5. Rapid Learners and Un-learners: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world




WHAT WE OFFER

 1. Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

 2. Collaborative and innovative environment

 3. Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

 4. Professional development opportunities



Target OTE is $125K -$200K To apply, please submit your resume. CodeRabbit is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion.

jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing, PLG
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.



Location: San Francisco Bay Area - Hybrid

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer



CodeRabbit helps engineering teams review code with higher signal, stronger context, and less drag on the pull-request workflow. As AI-generated code increases, the bottleneck moves downstream — teams still need to catch risk, understand intent, and merge with confidence.



We're hiring a Head of Growth Marketing, PLG to own the self-serve motion that's already showing real traction. Twenty-five percent of our revenue is already self-serve — developers and engineers are finding CodeRabbit, adopting it, and paying for it on their own. This role is about scaling what's working.



You'll own how individual developers discover, activate, and convert — managing all paid channels and leading a team of media planners and creatives to maximize both volume and efficiency across the self-serve funnel.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the full self-serve / PLG growth motion — from acquisition strategy to channel execution to funnel optimization.

 - Manage all paid acquisition channels: search, display, social, sponsorships, and emerging channels — with clear targets for volume, efficiency, and CAC.

 - Build and optimize direct-to-developer and direct-to-consumer acquisition programs that drive signups, activation, and conversion.

 - Lead and develop a team of media planners and creatives, setting a high bar for quality and performance.

 - Define the metrics that matter — CAC, LTV, ROAS, activation rates — and use them to make better investment decisions.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on growth experiments, onboarding improvements, and conversion opportunities.

 - Identify and test new acquisition channels before they become obvious.

 - Translate channel performance into clear business outcomes for senior leadership.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in growth marketing or paid acquisition leadership, including ownership of a company-level self-serve or PLG growth number.

 - Deep experience running direct-to-consumer and/or direct-to-developer acquisition programs at scale.

 - Proven track record managing all paid channels — search, display, social, sponsorships — with measurable results.

 - Experience leading a team of media planners and creatives.

 - Strong analytical mindset — you optimize with data, not instinct, and you can prove it.

 - Ability to balance volume and efficiency simultaneously — you know when to scale and when to cut.

 - Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you've had to build while running.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience marketing technical products to developers or engineering teams.

 - Familiarity with developer tools, AI infrastructure, or the modern software development lifecycle.

 - Experience taking a product from strong organic pull to a mature multi-channel acquisition engine.



What success looks like

 - More developers and engineering teams are finding CodeRabbit through repeatable, scalable acquisition channels.

 - Paid programs are running efficiently with clear attribution and improving unit economics over time.

 - The self-serve funnel converts faster, with a clearer path from first touch to activated user.

 - Growth decisions are grounded in cohort behavior, channel economics, and real customer evidence.

 - The team is high-performing, well-developed, and operating with a clear playbook.



CodeRabbit is building for a world where more code is written by agents, but accountability still belongs to engineering teams. If you want to own the growth motion that helps that market discover and adopt the product, we'd like to hear from you.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

CodeRabbit has meaningful momentum across both PLG and enterprise. This role will help turn that momentum into a disciplined, scalable enterprise growth engine—creating demand, improving conversion, and making CodeRabbit the obvious choice for engineering leaders at the world's most ambitious companies.



CodeRabbit is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

jobs.title: Regional Director of Pooled Customer Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.



Location: San Francisco, Hybrid




ABOUT THE TEAM

CodeRabbit is the AI code review platform. Development teams install it on their repositories and it reviews every pull request, so it sits in the daily workflow of a large and fast-growing customer base. The Scaled Success team is responsible for the health of that base. It is a team of a program manager, a content and enablement specialist, a success analytics engineer and a success operations manager, reporting to the Director of Scaled Success. The pooled customer success team is the next team to be added, and this role leads it.




THE ROLE

You build and run the pooled customer success team. Work arrives on a shared queue when a signal fires: onboarding has stalled, nothing has been configured, the only active user has gone quiet, a renewal is approaching, a cancellation has been started, or a team is using fewer seats than it has bought. The signals come from our configuration maturity model, which scores every account on how deeply it has set up the product, and from the automated campaigns that escalate when a customer needs a person.

You design the queue, write the routing rules, set the response standards, build the playbooks, hire the team, and measure whether the motion holds retention in the band it covers. You work directly with the Director, the Scaled Success program manager, the Success Analytics Engineer and the Content and Enablement Specialist.

This team runs on signals, and the help arrives when the customer needs it. The person who builds it will learn how to run customer success this way from the inside, and will have the data to show what works.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Hiring and managing the pooled customer success managers, starting with the first hires in your first quarter

 - Queue design: which signals create work, how work is prioritized, the response and resolution standards, and how a case closes

 - The routing rules between the digital, pooled and named lanes, including the escalation path out of digital and the hand-back when an account grows into named coverage

 - The playbook library, one per trigger: what a CSM does on a dormant account, a solo user, a stalled onboarding, a cancellation notice, an approaching renewal. Written with the Content and Enablement Specialist and kept current from what the queue teaches you

 - The save lane: cancellation and non-renewal signals routed to a person, the reason captured on every one, and the fixable ones fixed

 - The expansion hand-off: when the team surfaces seat headroom or a buying signal, the account goes to the account executive working the scaled lanes, with the context they need to close

 - The team's readout: queue volume by trigger, time to first response, time to resolution, configuration movement, and retention of covered accounts, built with the Success Analytics Engineer and read monthly

 - Capacity: how many accounts one person on the queue can carry, measured from the queue, and the case for extending pooled coverage further down the base as triggers and playbooks mature




YOUR FIRST QUARTER

 - Hire the first pooled customer success managers

 - Define the trigger set, the response standard for each trigger, and get the queue live in our tooling

 - Ship the first playbooks for the highest-volume triggers

 - Stand up the readout: queue volume by trigger, response and resolution times, and retention of covered accounts, reported on the team's measurement cadence




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years in customer success or technical support for a developer-facing product, with 2+ years managing people

 - You have built or run a shared-queue motion before: scaled success, a support desk, or a success pool where the team shared the work

 - You are technical enough for a code review product. You have shipped code, run CI, or supported developers doing both, and you can read a configuration file

 - You work from data. You can read a dashboard, question a number that looks wrong, and write a basic SQL query or specify the one you need

 - You have written operating procedures that other people followed

 - You are comfortable building where the playbook does not exist yet, and you document as you go




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with health scoring or trigger-based outreach in a success or support platform

 - Familiarity with Pylon, Customer.io http://Customer.io, PostHog, Salesforce or their equivalents

 - Familiar with AI tooling and examples of you using it in similar roles

 - You have used CodeRabbit or another AI code review tool on your own repositories




HOW WE WORK

The team runs on measured results. Campaigns ship with control groups, numbers are labeled by source, and every report traces to rules anyone can audit.
